title: When you need 'use client'
why_it_matters: You will hit this error many times, so know the fix.
explanation: Put 'use client' at the very top of a file when it needs state, effects, event handlers or browser APIs. Things like a file input, a click counter or localStorage all need it. Client-side tools are mostly client components.
try_it: Remove 'use client' from a component using useState and read the error.
